decisions.statement: An entry is one value under a declaration rather than a page.
An entry shape names the fields every entry under that shape has.
An entry is reached through the page that has the entry rather than by a slug.
The values a record property holds inline an entry shape holds in a file of its own.
A page states this property as the extension the file beside the page carries.
Every entry is judged against the fields its shape declares.
An entry arriving without an id is given an id as the entry lands.
An entry arriving in a whole body is given that id by the change writing the body.
An entry appended to the file rather than written with it is given an id too.
An entry's id is a uuid version 7 as a page's id is.

definition: a page property whose values are kept one to a line beside the page
